preconditions.description: The number of rows in the table is at least 1 and at most 100.
The number of columns in the table is at least 1 and at most 100.

postconditions.description: The output is a string of length n * m, where each character represents the color of a cell in the table.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i * m + j] <= output[i * m + j + 1] for i in range(n) for j in range(m - 1))
postconditions.description: The coloring is lexicographically minimum when read row by row from left to right.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i * m + j] <= output[(i + 1) * m + j] for i in range(n - 1) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The coloring is lexicographically minimum when read column by column from top to bottom.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i * m + j] == output[i * m + k] for j in range(m) for k in range(j + 1, m) if (i * m + j) // m == (i * m + k) // m) and all(output[i * m + j] == output[k * m + j] for i in range(n) for k in range(i + 1, n) if (i * m + j) % m == (k * m + j) % m)
postconditions.description: Each connected region of the same color forms a square.
